title.zh: Liquid AI发布LFM3，1.7B小模型跑网页Agent胜过9B

current_state.zh: Liquid AI launched the six-model LFM3 family, including a 1.7B text model with 256K context and strong web-agent benchmark results, while trailing larger models on complex coding and long-context tasks.
